<expire>    Soaring hills lift this verdant heath skyward.  Despite their height,
the summits are green, not stony.  In the rare places where the moorland
plants fail, only a smooth chalky soil is visible beneath.
The White Towers rise up to the east.
The sky is black and the stars shine down brightly.
The sky is brilliantly clear.
    The only obvious exits are <x>east</x>, <x>north</x>, <x>west</x> and <x>south</x>.
